why: This template directly tests the system's behavior under load to determine if throttling occurs and how it manifests.

predictions.predicts: The rapid burst of requests will result in a throttling error (e.g., 429 status) because the global shared limit is saturated.
The rapid burst of requests will succeed without error, as the hidden limit is high enough to accommodate 10 requests.

verdicts.because: 7 out of 10 requests were throttled, contradicting the prediction of success.

learned: 7 out of 10 requests were throttled, with the first throttling occurring on the 4th request.
